title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: When you one-hot encode a categorical variable, each category becomes a separate column. For example, if you have a column with three categories, it will be transformed into three binary columns.

title: Intercept Term in the Model
text: Including an intercept term in a model means adding a column of ones to the design matrix. This column accounts for the baseline level of the dependent variable when all other predictors are zero.

title: Counting Columns After Encoding
text: Consider how many columns are added when you one-hot encode the 'sex' and $$'embark_{town'}$$ columns. How many categories are there in each?
